title: Hand-made Tinplate Box Childhood Memories Model
body_html:
Product information:

Material: Wooden
Style: simple and stylish
Features: handmade
Colour: A: Five good families, B: Long live youth, C: After school


Production Instructions:

1. A detailed production manual is enclosed in the product packaging. Before making, you can prepare a set of auxiliary tools, such as scissors, tweezers, and rulers to measure size.
2. Mainly through the DIY process of polishing, digging and embedding, bonding, assembling, painting, sewing, modeling, placing, etc., create your own cabin.
3. The raw materials inside are divided into several small packages according to the material, which can be divided into several productions. It takes about three hours to several days to complete a finished Product.


Size Information:
17*12.5*7CM


Packing list:

Button battery switch*1
White latex*1
